rationale: The agent appears to have located the user and accessed order details, but proceeded to execute exchange actions without first obtaining explicit user confirmation, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing write. The agent also selected a replacement jigsaw without demonstrating that it met the requested constraints (fancier theme, 500 fewer pieces, same difficulty) or confirming the choice with the user, and used a specific payment method without user confirmation. Additionally, the conversation provides no tool results to substantiate that the items and orders belonged to the user or that the replacements matched specifications. The closing message implies completion without presenting confirmations or next steps (e.g., return labels), so the request was not completed in line with the policy.
